product_one_liner.value: Sona is an AI-powered workforce-management platform for large frontline organisations that helps managers make better staffing and operational decisions across locations.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage presents demo/contact calls to action and no public pricing link or priced plans.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index is a workforce-management news, research and product/industry insights blog; it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about how Sona is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage does not expose a public documentation site, help centre or developer portal in its navigation or footer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists Labour AI Specialist.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed public company and product materials describe AI/large language models but do not identify a specific model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed homepage/footer does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as a claimed certification.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists Account Executive, Enterprise Account Executive, Founding Account Executive and Business Development Representative roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Sona announced the launch of Sona LMS on 2026-06-22, within the six-month window before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On 2026-11-04, Sona's CEO announced Lee Gordon would step into the VP Sales North America role.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integrations page lists ATS, POS, care-planning, LMS, tipping, neutral-vendor, EWA and related systems, but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
